additional_hardening: New checkout attempts require the reviewed quote fingerprint; completed retries remain idempotent.
Quote fingerprints include address, current totals, child personalization and current admin field rules.
Equivalent Egyptian registration formats use a canonical local phone and unique-conflict handling.
Gallery URLs preserve the configured hybrid public storage disk.
Story photo counts follow existing configured rules; product photo counts follow their own admin schema.
excluded_changes: Website customer design approval and printing workflows
PDF library, favorites and identity feature implementation
Production customer records and payment state

frontend.skip_reason: Opt-in live local HEIC upload E2E was not enabled.

production.authenticated_journey: Requires an authorized customer account and confirmed isolation before submitting any real checkout.

deployment_guards: Validate application root, clean tracked files, exact fetched SHA and ancestor relationship to current deployed code.
Private database, tracked code and environment backup outside the web root before maintenance or code switch.
Apply phone_verified_at with the previous application before activating the new User model.
Preserve environment, untracked hosting files and existing media; do not reset or clean.
Install locked dependencies; rebuild config, routes and views; verify OTP disabled; restart queues and take application live.
backup_limits: Media files are unchanged and are not duplicated by this release backup. Native dump support is required; the script stops if backup fails.
failure_and_rollback: If activation fails, maintenance may remain enabled. Inspect the failure and the private previous-commit.txt. Code rollback can retain the additive phone_verified_at column; do not blindly restore the database or roll back unrelated migrations.
